node.title: Provider-free unmounted default-off canonical check-in environment-evidence admission-input seam rehearsal

notes: Yuri authorized uninterrupted completion and one bounded native-Harness contributor package under the pragmatic real-work plan.

decisions.summary: Call the accepted admission kernel first and apply the exact typed evidence check only to its ordinary activation-closed result.
A valid evidence reading remains denied, invalid readings fail closed and the authored-synthetic lane plus every older prerequisite remain unchanged.
Accept the exact Sol recovery after 278 deterministic passes and one clean Gemini 3.7 authority veto.
Both native attempts failed before provider delivery, produced no candidate and ended without retry or fallback; Sol recovery provenance is explicit.
Retain the traceability evidence but decline this exact native profile for the immediate next product tranche and open no generic diagnostic successor.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The git_refs_and_worktree source is prose-only and exact Git values come solely from the machine snapshot.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first runtime-state draft repeated exact Git object IDs in the narrative source and the preflight rejected manual Git-ref evidence.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The orchestrator preflight returned revision_required with git_refs_evidence_manual_object_id_forbidden.

correction.action: Remove the hand-authored IDs and let the preflight supply all exact Git readings.
correction.prevention_control: Git-ref narrative fields remain identity-free; exact objects are read only from the machine snapshot.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one rejected manual Git-ref narrative draft.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Repository paths are resolved from the file inventory before a read command is issued.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Two read commands guessed non-existent evaluator and admission-kernel artifact names before rg found the exact retained paths.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Get-Content failed closed with path-not-found and no file mutation.

correction.action: Resolve long artifact names with rg --files before reading them.
correction.prevention_control: Long generated artifact paths are inventory-resolved rather than reconstructed from memory.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records contained guessed-path read failures during rehydration.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every explicit path supplied to git add is copied from the verified file inventory.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: One test path used a hyphenated check-in segment instead of the actual underscore filename and the entire staging command failed.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Git rejected the unmatched pathspec before staging any path.

correction.action: Restage using the exact inventory-resolved underscore path and verify the cached diff.
correction.prevention_control: Explicit staging paths are copied from git status or rg output, not retyped from the document slug.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one contained explicit-path staging typo.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The reusable coordinator imports repository modules identically under pytest and direct script execution.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first direct prepare invocation failed before attempt creation because the script did not insert the repository root on sys.path.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Python raised ImportError for the accepted effective-tool guard module; zero worktree and zero provider call existed.

correction.action: Bind REPO_ROOT before importing scripts and prove the direct --help path plus focused tests.
correction.prevention_control: Directly executable repository coordinators self-bind their repository import root before package imports.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the corrected direct-execution import-root defect.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every selected future test path contains at least one collectible test before command-manifest admission.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The second zero-provider preparation rejected the deliberately empty worker-owned test scaffold as containing no tests.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The command-manifest validator returned selected_test_contains_no_tests before worktree retention or provider execution.

correction.action: Add one explicit skipped scaffold test that the worker must replace.
correction.prevention_control: Worker-owned test scaffolds are collectible before they enter a fixed command manifest.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the corrected empty test-scaffold admission defect.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The HMR-loaded custom runner reaches the exact three-tool composition before any provider request.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: HMR completed but the runner emitted CUSTOM_RUNNER_FAILURE before a provider request and the first terminal lacked a safe subcoordinate.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The attempt-001 terminal recorded provider not_reached, candidate none, HMR complete, zero requests and complete process cleanup.

correction.action: Add the accepted sanitized effective-tool coordinate, remove the extra persistence overlay and make retry artifacts attempt-scoped.
correction.prevention_control: Every pre-provider runner setup failure emits a closed guard coordinate and each fresh attempt has distinct boundary files.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records attempt 001's attributable pre-provider custom-runner failure.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The accepted emr4-bounded-worker preset mounts in the fresh real-work custom-runner context and exposes exactly edit/glob/read.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The final allowed attempt completed HMR but failed at EFFECTIVE_TOOL_COMPOSITION_PRESET_MOUNT_FAILED before provider delivery.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The attempt-002 terminal recorded provider not_reached, candidate none, exact guard coordinate, zero retry/fallback and complete cleanup.

correction.action: End the native assignment with no third run, no diagnostic successor and explicit Sol recovery provenance.
correction.prevention_control: This exact profile is not selected again until non-diagnostic evidence shows its preset-mount boundary is fixed.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the contained final native-Harness preset-mount failure and zero candidate.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A missing optional snapshot binding returns ordinary_evidence_missing without raising.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first Sol implementation built an all tuple eagerly, so regex fullmatch received None despite an earlier false type predicate.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Two focused hostile-binding tests raised TypeError before the candidate commit.

correction.action: Move primitive type and syntax validation into explicit early-return guards before equality predicates.
correction.prevention_control: Hostile optional values are type-gated before regex or other type-specific operations.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the corrected eager predicate-evaluation TypeError.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The reviewer source is supplied as a machine-read full 40-character object without shell-sensitive revision syntax.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: An unquoted PowerShell rev-parse brace expression was encoded as an invalid Git argument and the first worktree-creation command stopped before mutation.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Git rejected the ambiguous encoded argument and the explicit full-OID assertion stopped the command.

correction.action: Read the already exact current HEAD directly and pass that verified full object to git worktree add.
correction.prevention_control: PowerShell review-worktree setup uses machine-read full OIDs and no brace-suffixed revision expressions.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one contained PowerShell Git revision-expression lapse.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The fresh Antigravity process exits and releases the disposable clean review directory after its terminal receipt.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The launcher left the fresh agy process holding the now-empty review directory, so git removed metadata but could not remove the directory until that exact process was stopped.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Git worktree removal returned Windows permission denied; the directory was empty and the matching newly started agy process remained live.

correction.action: Verify the directory was empty, stop only the exact newly started agy process and remove the exact validated directory.
correction.prevention_control: Verifier cleanup checks the fresh launcher process and releases its directory handle before final worktree-absence readback.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the contained fresh Antigravity directory-handle cleanup defect.
